summary.goal: Implement pipeline Step 7: LLM synthesis that receives a PreExtract (NOT raw transcript) and produces structured Nuggets. The LLM handles semantic synthesis — the 'why', not the 'what'. This includes: prompt construction from PreExtract fields, single API call to Claude Haiku (default), structured output parsing into Nugget[], trail decision shortcut (pre-structured decisions bypass LLM entirely), and Tier 0 fallback mode (no API key = deterministic extraction only, still produces value). The prompt is tightly structured with explicit categories and rules.

acceptance_criteria.description: synthesizeNuggets(preExtract) returns Nugget[] from one LLM call
LLM prompt includes: ENTITIES, TOOL CALLS, FILES MODIFIED, KEY EVENTS, EXISTING TOPICS, DECISIONS, RETROSPECTIVE sections from PreExtract
LLM prompt includes filtered transcript excerpt (not raw session data)
LLM prompt specifies 5 categories: DECISIONS, CONSTRAINTS, PATTERNS, GOTCHAS, CONTEXT
LLM prompt includes rules: self-contained nuggets, 2-4 lines max, ruthlessly selective, no greetings/chatter/tool output, causal links via Caused: slug
LLM output parsed into Nugget[] with each nugget assigned to existing or proposed topic slug
Pre-structured trail decisions from PreExtract.facts (type: 'decision' with reasoning) become Decision nuggets WITHOUT LLM processing
When all extractable knowledge is pre-structured (all trail decisions), LLM call is skipped entirely
LLM model and API key are configurable (default: Claude Haiku, @anthropic-ai/sdk)
maxTokensIn: 2000, maxTokensOut: 500 — tightly bounded to control cost
If no LLM API key is configured, return only pre-structured nuggets from trail decisions (Tier 0 mode)
LLM response parsing is resilient to minor format deviations — doesn't fail on imperfect output
Cost per session: ~$0.001-0.004 depending on session length
PreExtract chunking: if filteredTranscript exceeds maxTokensIn (2000), split into chunks by FilteredExcerpt boundaries and make multiple LLM calls, then concatenate Nugget arrays
Fact-to-Nugget transformation: Facts with isPreStructured=true are converted to Nuggets directly — slug from kebab-case of title, category='decision', body from reasoning field
LLM output validation: use LlmNuggetOutputSchema.safeParse() on each nugget — drop individual nuggets that fail validation rather than failing the entire LLM call
Tier 0 mode: full deterministic extraction produces pre-structured nuggets only (from trail decisions). Non-trail entities/facts are still extracted but not synthesized into nuggets without LLM.

observations: The LLM sees ONLY the PreExtract, never raw session data — this is a key design constraint
Prompt structure is fully specified in spec section 5.2 — not much design work needed, just implement
Trail decision shortcut (spec 5.3) is elegant: if decision already has title + reasoning, it IS a nugget
Tier 0 fallback means mull is useful even without an API key — deterministic extraction alone produces trail decision nuggets
Token limits (2K in, 500 out) keep per-session cost at ~$0.001 for Haiku
For longer sessions, multiple LLM calls may be needed (2-4) — PreExtract may need chunking
LLM output format should be structured (JSON or labeled sections) for reliable parsing
Spec says ~100 lines for synthesize.ts — prompt construction + API call + parsing
concerns: LLM output parsing reliability: structured JSON output is more reliable than freeform text, but Haiku may not always comply
PreExtract chunking for long sessions: when does one call become 2-3? Need clear boundary (token count threshold)

steps.title: Build prompt template from PreExtract
steps.description: Create the prompt construction function that assembles a structured prompt from PreExtract fields. Prompt includes labeled sections: ENTITIES, TOOL CALLS, FILES MODIFIED, KEY EVENTS, EXISTING TOPICS, DECISIONS, RETROSPECTIVE, and the filtered transcript excerpt. Specifies 5 nugget categories (DECISIONS, CONSTRAINTS, PATTERNS, GOTCHAS, CONTEXT) and rules (self-contained, 2-4 lines max, ruthlessly selective, no greetings/chatter/tool output, causal links via Caused: slug). Prompt requests JSON output conforming to LlmNuggetOutputSchema.

acceptance_criteria.description: Prompt includes all PreExtract sections: ENTITIES, TOOL CALLS, FILES MODIFIED, KEY EVENTS, EXISTING TOPICS, DECISIONS, RETROSPECTIVE
Prompt includes filtered transcript excerpt from PreExtract.filteredTranscript
Prompt specifies 5 categories: DECISIONS, CONSTRAINTS, PATTERNS, GOTCHAS, CONTEXT
Prompt includes rules: self-contained nuggets, 2-4 lines max, ruthlessly selective, no greetings/chatter/tool output, causal links via Caused: slug
Prompt requests structured JSON output for reliable parsing

steps.specification: Location: src/synthesize/prompt.ts. Export buildPrompt(preExtract: PreExtract): string. Template is a tagged template literal with sections populated from PreExtract fields. Each section header in CAPS for LLM clarity. Entities listed as comma-separated. Facts formatted as timestamped bullet points. Filtered transcript as quoted blocks. End with explicit JSON output format specification.

steps.title: Implement LLM call wrapper with chunking
steps.description: Build the LLM call wrapper that sends the constructed prompt to Claude Haiku (default, configurable). Implements PreExtract chunking: if the assembled prompt exceeds maxTokensIn (2000 tokens), split the filteredTranscript into chunks by FilteredExcerpt boundaries and make multiple LLM calls, then concatenate the resulting Nugget arrays. Uses @anthropic-ai/sdk. Model and API key are configurable. maxTokensIn: 2000, maxTokensOut: 500 per call.

acceptance_criteria.description: Calls Claude Haiku by default via @anthropic-ai/sdk, model configurable
maxTokensIn: 2000, maxTokensOut: 500 per LLM call
When prompt exceeds maxTokensIn, splits by FilteredExcerpt boundaries into multiple chunks
Multiple chunk results concatenated into single Nugget[] array
Token estimation uses simple heuristic (chars/4) for chunking decisions
API key checked before call — returns empty array if missing (caller handles Tier 0)

steps.specification: Location: src/synthesize/llm.ts. Export callLlm(prompt: string, opts: LlmConfig): Promise<string>. Export synthesizeWithLlm(preExtract: PreExtract, opts: LlmConfig): Promise<RawLlmNugget[]>. LlmConfig: { model?: string, apiKey?: string, maxTokensIn?: number, maxTokensOut?: number }. Chunk splitting: estimate tokens as prompt.length/4, if > maxTokensIn, split filteredTranscript by FilteredExcerpt array boundaries, rebuild prompt per chunk with shared context (entities, facts, topics) but different transcript excerpts.

steps.title: Implement output parser with safeParse validation
steps.description: Build the LLM output parser that converts raw LLM response text into validated Nugget[]. Parse JSON from LLM response (handle markdown code fences, trailing commas, common LLM JSON quirks). Validate each nugget individually using LlmNuggetOutputSchema.safeParse() — drop individual nuggets that fail validation rather than failing the entire call. Log warnings for dropped nuggets. Assign each valid nugget to its specified topic slug.

acceptance_criteria.description: Parses JSON from LLM response, handling markdown code fences and common JSON quirks
Validates each nugget individually using LlmNuggetOutputSchema.safeParse()
Drops individual nuggets that fail validation — does not fail entire call
Logs warnings with Zod error details for each dropped nugget
Assigns each valid nugget to its specified topic slug from LLM output
Resilient to minor format deviations: trailing commas, missing optional fields, extra whitespace

steps.specification: Location: src/synthesize/parser.ts. Export parseLlmOutput(raw: string): Nugget[]. Strip markdown code fences (```json...```). Try JSON.parse, fallback to lenient parsing (strip trailing commas, fix unquoted keys). LlmNuggetOutputSchema is a Zod schema matching: { slug: string, category: enum, title: string, body: string, topic?: string, caused?: string }. Use .safeParse() per item, filter out { success: false } entries.

steps.title: Implement trail decision shortcut (Fact-to-Nugget)
steps.description: Build the deterministic Fact-to-Nugget transformation for pre-structured trail decisions. Facts with isPreStructured=true are converted directly to Nuggets without LLM processing: slug generated from kebab-case of decision title, category set to 'decision', body populated from the reasoning field. This is the highest-signal, lowest-cost path through the pipeline.

acceptance_criteria.description: Facts with isPreStructured=true converted to Nuggets directly
Nugget slug generated from kebab-case of decision title
Nugget category set to 'decision'
Nugget body populated from fact's reasoning/description field
When ALL facts are pre-structured and no non-trail entities need synthesis, LLM call is skipped entirely

steps.specification: Location: src/synthesize/trail-shortcut.ts. Export convertPreStructuredFacts(facts: Fact[]): Nugget[]. Filter facts where isPreStructured === true. kebab-case slug: title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, ''). Export shouldSkipLlm(preExtract: PreExtract): boolean — returns true when all extractable knowledge comes from pre-structured facts (no non-trail entities/facts that would benefit from LLM synthesis).

steps.title: Implement Tier 0 fallback and synthesizeNuggets orchestrator
steps.description: Build the main synthesizeNuggets(preExtract, opts) function that orchestrates the full synthesis flow. First, convert pre-structured facts to nuggets via trail shortcut. Then check: if shouldSkipLlm returns true OR no API key configured (Tier 0 mode), return only pre-structured nuggets. Otherwise, build prompt, call LLM (with chunking if needed), parse output, validate, and concatenate with pre-structured nuggets. Tier 0 clarification: non-trail entities/facts are still extracted in the PreExtract but are NOT synthesized into nuggets without LLM — they exist for future LLM processing.

acceptance_criteria.description: synthesizeNuggets(preExtract, opts) returns combined Nugget[] from trail shortcut + LLM
Pre-structured trail decision nuggets always included regardless of LLM availability
Tier 0 mode (no API key): returns only pre-structured nuggets, non-trail data left unsynthesized
When shouldSkipLlm is true, LLM call is skipped even if API key is available
LLM nuggets deduplicated against pre-structured nuggets by slug
Partial failure: if LLM call throws, pre-structured nuggets are still returned (error logged, not propagated)

steps.specification: Location: src/synthesize/index.ts. Export synthesizeNuggets(preExtract: PreExtract, opts?: SynthesizeOpts): Promise<Nugget[]>. SynthesizeOpts: { model?: string, apiKey?: string, maxTokensIn?: number, maxTokensOut?: number }. Flow: 1) trailNuggets = convertPreStructuredFacts(preExtract.facts), 2) if shouldSkipLlm(preExtract) || !opts?.apiKey → return trailNuggets, 3) llmNuggets = synthesizeWithLlm(preExtract, opts), 4) deduplicate by slug (trail wins), 5) return [...trailNuggets, ...llmNuggets].

steps.title: Write synthesis layer tests
steps.description: Comprehensive test suite for the synthesis layer. Tests prompt construction completeness, LLM call with chunking behavior, output parser resilience (valid JSON, code-fenced JSON, malformed individual nuggets dropped, trailing commas), trail decision shortcut (slug generation, category assignment, body population), Tier 0 fallback (no API key returns only pre-structured), partial failure (LLM error still returns trail nuggets), and deduplication logic.

acceptance_criteria.description: Prompt tests: all PreExtract sections included, categories specified, rules present
Chunking tests: large filteredTranscript split by FilteredExcerpt boundaries, results concatenated
Parser tests: valid JSON parsed, code fences stripped, individual invalid nuggets dropped with warning, trailing commas handled
Trail shortcut tests: isPreStructured facts converted to nuggets with correct slug (kebab-case), category (decision), body (reasoning)
Tier 0 tests: no API key returns only pre-structured nuggets; shouldSkipLlm returns true when all facts are pre-structured
Partial failure tests: LLM error caught, pre-structured nuggets still returned
Deduplication tests: trail nuggets win over LLM nuggets with same slug

steps.specification: Location: src/synthesize/__tests__/synthesize.test.ts. Use Vitest. Mock @anthropic-ai/sdk for LLM call tests. Create PreExtract fixtures with various combinations of pre-structured and non-pre-structured facts. Test parser with realistic LLM output strings including edge cases.
